title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.17 (versions follow prime numbers), the lamp of the present: Luma, always awake, no longer fills the disk. Everything that Luma is stays whole (forms, meals, memory, bodies, lexicons, code); each event log becomes a ring of its latest lines, and a header counts every line ever written per reason, so nothing leaves without its reason. Measured with the window open: the home stays flat (2,727,920 bytes at minute 1, 2,728,243 at minutes 6 and 31), ~9-11% of a core. A migration took an existing home from 175.7 MB to 2.7 MB with its learned state intact; the shipped home is 263 KB zipped. The independent check now verifies the window and the per-reason counts, 0 mismatches; it can no longer replay from birth. OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.17: la lámpara del presente — Luma siempre despierta sin llenar el disco. Prototipo de investigación.
